In the 880 Yds. a fair field was seen and in rather a slow run race Dick Michael, the holder, came away as they neared home and beat Fred White, with Alby Bird gaining third place.

Dick Michael raises a subject that has perplexed generations of athletes. Can a man be trained by someone else with greater success than he can train himself (helped by his club senior members), determined to achieve success?

Our team ran impressively in their heat, and in the final Eddie Pack gave our team a splendid start, unofficial watches timing him to do a shade outside 50 seconds. Dick Michael then took over, and striding magnificently, retained the lead, although our opponents were gaining.

Herbert was a good second; and Dick Michael, the holder, had to be content with third place. For the first time we held a Junior 880 yards race, and although there was only a small field, it was a most interesting contest.

Dick Michael was a close fourth and Frank Webb was the other finalist. For three recognised half-milers to figure in a sprint final does not say much for the quality of our sprinters; but perhaps the handicapper was kind to them!
Arthur Beaumont, Fred White, Dick Michael, Ted Stimpson, Percy Wright, Alby Bird, Joe Daly and George Murray are also frequent strollers, and now the prodigal Alf Taylor has returned to the fold.

Then we had Dick Michael 4th, Harry Shields 5th, and Arthur Allum 9th. We won the team race by scoring 20 points to Micham's A.C.'s 22, a narrow margin but a winning one.

…Morrell 6th, all our runners in this race scored points to put us in the lead. The 880 yards was won by Alby Bird, with Dick Michael second. They had a ding-dong struggle which took them well away from their field.…
The S.A.A.L. 4 x 440 yards was also down for decision and we had to ask Jarlett and Gray to turn out once more for the Club, together with Dick Michael and Frank Webb.
Dick Michael made a fine substitute, however, and he ran well to beat Flynn of T.V.H., while Frank Webb sportingly turned out and gained points by finishing 4th.
